# Alfaazo

> Alfaazo is a free language learning app for mastering Punjabi. It teaches Gurmukhi script, everyday phrases, and real-world conversations through bite-sized lessons. Built by Codefeb. Available on iOS and Android.

## App Features
- Gurmukhi script lessons with stroke-by-stroke writing guides

- Real-world conversations rooted in cultural context

- Cultural context: Punjabi proverbs, food, festivals, traditions
- Progress tracking with learning streaks
- Designed for heritage speakers and new learners alike

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is Punjabi hard to learn?
Punjabi is approachable for beginners. Gurmukhi is a phonetic script — every letter maps to one sound. Most learners pick up basic reading within 2-3 weeks.

### What is the best app to learn Punjabi?
Alfaazo is a free app designed specifically for Punjabi. It teaches Gurmukhi script with stroke-by-stroke guides, everyday phrases with native audio, and conversations with cultural context.

### How long does it take to learn Punjabi?
With 15-20 minutes of daily practice, most learners can read Gurmukhi within 2-3 weeks, hold basic conversations within 2-3 months, and achieve conversational fluency in 6-12 months.

### What is the difference between Punjabi and Hindi?
Punjabi uses Gurmukhi script (Hindi uses Devanagari), Punjabi is tonal (Hindi is not), and about 60-70% of basic vocabulary is shared between the two languages.

### Can I learn Punjabi for free?
Yes. Alfaazo is completely free on iOS and Android with Gurmukhi lessons, phrases, pronunciation practice, and culturally-rooted conversations.

### How do I learn Punjabi online for free?
Download Alfaazo on iOS or Android. The app provides structured lessons, native audio, and cultural context — all free. The Alfaazo blog also offers learning guides and tips.
